summary: Installed and loaded the S009 launchd scheduler (com.algo.s009-paper), which had never actually been running: no plist under ~/Library/LaunchAgents, no launchd job, no cron entry -- since the last manual run on 2026-08-06 the paper ledger/state had gone stale (last_day stuck at 2026-08-05) while 4 real positions sat open on the dedicated Bybit-algo009 mainnet account with nothing auto-rebalancing them. Fixed a real bug this exposed in scripts/s009_tick.py: tick() defaulted its now parameter to timezone-aware UTC (datetime.now(timezone.utc)), but utils/trade_logger.py writes event timestamp fields as naive local time, so _has_event_today's since-cutoff comparison raised "can't compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes" on every idle tick once a heartbeat had already been logged for the day -- same failure signature as the two "S009 cycle subprocess exited non-zero" entries already in S009.log from 2026-08-03. Changed the default to naive local time (matching the logger and scripts/s007_tick.py's own default); this now parameter only affects heartbeat dedup/log-file day-naming, not the actual UTC trading-day boundary (_expected_last_closed_day() is independent of it). Added tests/scripts/test_s009_tick.py (regression test replays the exact two-consecutive-idle-ticks crash, plus branch coverage for the needs-cycle/timeout/nonzero-exit/state-did-not-advance paths, mirroring tests/scripts/test_s007_tick.py's structure). Per explicit user confirmation, also switched deployment/com.algo.s009-paper.plist from --broker off (shadow-only) to --broker execute --allow-mainnet, so the scheduler now auto-rebalances the real mainnet book daily; verified via BybitExec.positions()/wallet_equity() (read-only) that the reload itself placed no orders.

Migrated S009's real-money execution off its legacy launchd path onto the DB-driven Docker/Ofelia path, per Anton's explicit decision (previously webapp/runner.py::_worker_s009 hardcoded broker='off' unconditionally, per the 2026-08-10 note that enabling real orders there was 'a separate, explicit decision to make later'). Added AccountStrategy.broker_mode ('off'/'dry'/'execute', default 'off', migration 004) so real-order gating is per (account,strategy) link, not a single global switch -- flipping Bybit-algo009's S009 link to 'execute' cannot silently promote the second registered S009 account (Bybit-tradebot1, left 'off'). _worker_s009 now also requires Account.env=='mainnet' before allow_mainnet=True, mirroring bot/bybit_exec.py::BybitExec's own guard. Verified end-to-end against the live account before cutover: ran the real worker with broker_mode='dry' (real credentials, real Bybit mainnet equity fetch, no orders placed) and confirmed the computed rebalance plan (close stale ATOM position, open TRX/INJ/DOGE/NEAR) matched what the legacy launchd path had already computed today, then flipped to 'execute'. Decommissioned the legacy path: unloaded launchd job com.algo.s009-paper (via scripts/s009_tick_install.sh uninstall) after confirming today's real rebalance had already settled through it (loop_settled today=2026-08-13, so no coverage gap before the DB path's next scheduled run), and added DEPRECATED headers to scripts/s009_tick.py + deployment/com.algo.s009-paper.plist mirroring S007's 2026-08-10 deprecation pattern exactly (break-glass fallback only, explicit warning not to run both paths against the same account at once). Rebuilt algo-worker:latest (picking up this change plus ALGODEV-9's Deribit snapshot collector and other already-tree-resident work, per Anton's explicit choice to rebuild with all uncommitted WIP as-is) and smoke-tested the new image directly (pyarrow import, scripts.fetch_deribit_snapshot import, schedule.yml task/strategy parsing, webapp.runner + BrokerMode import) plus confirmed a live Ofelia dispatch tick against it succeeds. 27 webapp tests pass (24 pre-existing + 3 new broker_mode-gating cases); ruff clean on all touched files.

Fixed a real-money bug found while checking bot status: run_cycle_for_account() constructed BybitExec without ever passing env, so it always fell back to the BYBIT_TESTNET OS env var -- unset in the Ofelia dispatch container (not in docker-compose.ymls environment list, and .env is deliberately excluded from the image per .dockerignore with a since-stale bind-mount comment that was never implemented). Result: every DB-driven S009 cycle for Bybit-algo009 (a real-money MAINNET account, broker_mode=execute) silently hit api-testnet.bybit.com with its mainnet-only API key, 401ing (API key is invalid) and completely failing the cycle -- no rebalance, no equity read, nothing -- for about 17h (2026-08-13 21:05 UTC through 2026-08-14 14:xx UTC when this was caught), even though _worker_s009 already computed allow_mainnet from acc.env correctly (that only gates ORDER PLACEMENT, not which base URL/credential namespace BybitExec talks to). Added env: str | None = None to run_cycle_for_account, threaded through to both BybitExec(...) constructor call sites, and _worker_s009 now passes env=acc.env. Added regression tests in both tests/bot/test_s009_paper.py and tests/webapp/test_runner_s009.py (the existing allow_mainnet-focused tests never asserted on env at all -- confirmed both new tests fail against the pre-fix code and pass after). Rebuilt algo-worker, manually ran python -m webapp.runner --strategy S009 in-container to verify live: broker env=mainnet equity=102.48 mode=execute, caught up the missed 2026-08-13 day (net_ret=+1.6%), placed 4 of 6 real orders (2 rejected on a pre-existing, unrelated Bybit $5-minimum-order-value issue, not touched here). account_strategy id=3 status is now clean (no last_error).
